hooks.prompt: Bash output >20 lines or >500 chars: pipe through ctx_execute immediately.
Large MCP output: use ctx_execute or ctx_batch_execute.
Source code: prefer Octocode (def/refs), CodeGraphContext (callers), Repomix (dir overview). Allow Read/Grep for non-code.
Directory overview: use Repomix. Single-file reads: allow normally.
